evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature reads 437.4 °C, markedly discordant with the other column temperatures near 63–70 °C.

T701 remains extremely high at 439.5 °C after reaching 439.6 °C; other temperatures remain 63.3–70.4 °C. This persistent discrepancy requires verification and does not by itself identify thermocouple drift.
Reflux and distillate flows are 0.1 and 0.2 L/h, giving an instantaneous ratio of 0.5, whereas FYI702 reads 6.8; the ratio definition and timing need verification.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler temperature, T701 calibration and unit validation, expected operating temperatures and safety limits are needed to distinguish genuine overheating from a measurement fault. Verify FYI702 definition and synchronization with flow measurements. Pressure channels are not installed, so pressure-related causes cannot be assessed directly. No composition measurement or target separation specification is provided.
